methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Status and numerical progress refer to the dated evidence, not a live performance rating. Joint government, constituency, party and agency roles are identified. Unknown outcomes remain NULL. Additional research may extend the initial pass.

mumtaz-md-nawi.scope: Initial bounded source pass, up to two relevant milestones per person. Further commitments remain not_researched_to_completion.
mumtaz-md-nawi.unselected_commitments: No further dated personal commitment or clearly attributable delivery was selected. Parliamentary questions, other ministers’ promises, attendance at events and general aspirations were not converted into personal delivery claims.
mumtaz-md-nawi.completion: NULL unless supported by a comparable, dated published metric.
mumtaz-md-nawi.party_membership: Supported by the linked current representative or party sources.
mumtaz-md-nawi.milestone_research_status: not_established_in_reviewed_sources; not a claim that no commitments exist
